description: The robot's server-to-client topics in the Message oneof of platform_shared/message.proto, by tag, with their kind. A state topic holds one current value: a subscribe to it is answered with that value (the snapshot), then with the subscribe echoed as its ack, and every change follows; a push a client could not take is sent again, as the current value, once it can. A stream topic is a sequence of frames: a subscribe to it is answered with the ack alone, and its frames follow while the client subscribes. A subscribe to a tag that is no topic is acked as a stream. The firmware's table (esp32/include/communication/topics.h, test esp32/test/host/topic_snapshot_test.cpp) and the app's (app/src/lib/transport/topics.ts, test app/tests/unit/topics.spec.ts) are both checked against this file.
